name: a chip filters by first type only
why: Image 2 is Back + Front; the Front chip counts 2, so it must show both. Comparing types[0] shows 1 while the chip says 2.

name: chip counts only the first type of each image
why: The count must match what the chip shows; an image with two types counts for both.

name: the layout is switched but never stored
why: Remembering is the decision; asserting only the click would pass on code that writes nothing.

edits.find: try { GM_setValue(_artSectionOf(sec).layoutKey, lay.dataset.mbArtLayout); } catch (_) { /* storage blocked: still switch */ }

name: a stored layout is ignored on load
why: A fresh load seeded with 'grouped' must open grouped.

name: the tile carries no hover card
why: The card is data-mbtt on the tile; without it the shared engine has nothing to show.
grep: hovering a tile shows its own liner card

name: the card's position within its type is wrong
why: "Liner 1 of 4" is computed from the record; an off-by-one or a count of all images would be wrong yet look plausible.
grep: hovering a tile shows its own liner card

name: the sheet is not capped at the window width
why: On a release whose tracklist container is far wider than the window, the grid spread all tiles into one long row.
grep: tapping a tile shows no hover card

name: a broken thumbnail can spill out of its tile
why: A 404 thumbnail (the archive was down on 2026-10-06) renders as alt text and ignores aspect-ratio; the link box must clip it, or it covers the next tile.
